title: A frozen exam per model type and the gate against forgetting
request: The owner: models trained again must not forget old skills; a frozen exam, replay, versions kept.
spec: Phase 12 plan 36.4: an exam per model type drawn once from sealed rows plus general skills, pinned, never trained on; every version sits it; a version is promoted only if no section dropped beyond its interval.
plan: Take over the helper session's contract and store module.
Write the contract and store tests.
Dry-run the draw on the real store.

decisions.decision: A section with fewer than 10 groups is judged item by item and named weakly protected
decisions.why: a bootstrap over two groups cannot bound a drop: a version that lost half a section passed

decisions.decision: A version is also compared with the first version accepted and still standing
decisions.why: small losses each inside the interval could add up across versions
a drawn exam is pinned for good; the first draw is the owner's decision

decisions.decision: A tuned model with no exam result is not served once the store holds exams; an unreadable record blocks it
decisions.why: the plan says every version sits its exam; a failure to read must not let a model through

change: dclab_core/exam.py (Exam, ExamResult, no_forgetting), contracts and conformance entries, schemas; dclab_rnd/store/exams.py, store/layout.py, store/sets/__init__.py (exam rows held out of train and dev), models/tuned.py; tests.

findings.defect: No exam could be written or read
findings.scenario: the exam's file name was upper-case and the store's layout refuses such names
findings.cause: file names passed through the folder-name check

findings.defect: On the real store no exam could be drawn for three model types
findings.scenario: exam rows repeated in train and dev splits (one content 979 times) and rows of one entry shared a key
findings.cause: the draw never skipped rows already in training, kept copies of one content, and keyed rows without a place by their entry
findings.fix: skip rows whose key or content is in train or dev, one item per content, the whole id as the key

findings.defect: The gate passed a version that forgot half a section
findings.scenario: 100 items in 2 groups, one group lost: pass, interval [-1, 0]
findings.cause: weak protection judged by items while the bootstrap drew groups
findings.fix: below 10 groups the bootstrap draws items and the section is named weakly protected
findings.impact: ten real sections had 20 or more items in two groups

findings.defect: A tuned model that never sat its exam, or whose record could not be read, could be promoted
findings.scenario: no standing returned None and nothing was missing; any error was swallowed
findings.fix: missing exam and unreadable record each block promotion once the store holds exams; the lookup reads only exams' own records
findings.open: a served model is not stopped by a later refusal, and models are matched by served name

findings.defect: Small losses could add up across versions
findings.scenario: five versions each losing two of forty items, each passing
findings.cause: only the last accepted version was the comparison
findings.fix: also against the first accepted version still standing

findings.defect: Model version names the store refuses could not sit
findings.scenario: an Ollama-style name with a colon raised a path error
findings.cause: the version used as a file name
findings.fix: a slug and a short hash name the file; the name stays inside; exam versions without a colon

measurements.name: dry draw of every model type's exam on the real store
measurements.gate: every type with sealed rows that have an answer gets an exam that verify finds in no train or dev split
measurements.result: seven of eight types clean (m1 1,097 items, m2 299, m3 2,409, m4 309, m5 439, m6 483, m7 16); m8 has no sealed row with an answer
measurements.against_gate: seven clean of the seven types with answerable sealed rows
limits: nothing drawn or pinned: a dry run
m7's exam rests on 16 distinct rows

outcome: The frozen exam and its gate are built and reviewed: rows already in training are never drawn, a version that forgot a section is refused even when the section has few groups, small losses cannot add up, and a tuned model without a readable passing result is not promoted once exams exist. Seven of eight model types can be drawn cleanly; the first draw waits for the owner.
lessons: A bootstrap over groups needs enough groups; with few, draw items and say the section is weakly protected.
Draw an exam only from rows that are nowhere in training, by key and by content.
risks: A drawn exam is permanent: a bad first draw is costly.
